title: Leaf seed selection
statement: Given a triple of seeds $(s_0,s_1,s_2)$ from a three-element set and a block $b$ from a three-element set, the leaf seed is $s_0$ when $b=0$, $s_1$ when $b=1$, and $s_2$ otherwise.
